opinions.note: AP reports that the November 3, 2026 elections gave the Democratic caucus a 56–44 Senate majority for January 2027, exceeding the 51-seat threshold.
The Associated Press reported that Democratic candidates won at least 258 of 435 U.S. House seats in the November 3, 2026 general election, exceeding the 218-seat threshold.
The Wikipedia article and AP race calls show the Democratic Party won at least 259 of the 435 House seats in the November 3, 2026 general election, well above the 218 seats needed for a majority.

Following the November 3, 2026 general elections, the Democratic Caucus (comprising 54 Democrats and 2 caucusing independents) won a 56-44 majority in the US Senate, exceeding the 51 seats required for control.
UKMTO’s corrected warning confirms that an unknown projectile struck a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz at 20:25 UTC on 22 November 2026, which was 00:25 Gulf Standard Time on 23 November 2026.

ČTK reported that the cabinet approved Czech participation in SAFE’s second round, and the Defence Ministry’s transcript of Zůna’s November 24 remarks confirms that the approval took place on November 23.
The Ukrainian Air Force’s first morning summary counted 96 UAVs launched from 18:00 Kyiv time on November 23, below the threshold of 130.

The Ukrainian Air Force's morning summary on 24 November 2026 (also repeated by Ukrinform and The Kyiv Independent) reported that Russia launched 96 strike and decoy UAVs overnight from 18:00 on 23 November, which is fewer than 130.
RTP reports that Portugal’s Assembleia da República approved the 2027 State Budget bill in the final overall vote on November 24, 2026, with more votes in favour than against.

The Commission’s opinion adopted on 24 November 2026 concludes that France’s 2027 draft budgetary plan complies with the net expenditure growth limit in the Council’s excessive deficit procedure recommendation, despite uncertainty from ongoing parliamentary discussions. ([economy-finance.ec.europa.eu](https://economy-finance.ec.europa.eu/document/download/d9859437-3474-40c0-a9a9-3c4924ee7601_en?fi

UKMTO Warnings 219-26 (Update 001), 220-26, and 221-26 report three separate attacks in which eastbound tankers in the Strait of Hormuz were struck by unknown projectiles on 22 November 2026 at 20:25, 20:32, and 20:42 UTC (which corresponds to 00:25, 00:32, and 00:42 Gulf Standard Time on 23 November 2026, inside the event window).

UKMTO warnings 218-26 through 221-26 (published on 24 November 2026) were time-late reports for incidents that occurred on 22 November 2026, and the subsequent warning 222-26 was for an incident on 25 November 2026, leaving no qualifying incident reported by UKMTO or JMIC that took place on 24 November 2026.
The four strikes UKMTO reported on November 24 occurred before the Gulf-time window, and no UKMTO or JMIC report reviewed identified a qualifying incident within it.

ECO reports that Portugal's Parliament approved the 2027 State Budget in the final overall vote (votação final global) on Tuesday, 24 November 2026, with PSD and CDS-PP voting in favour and PS and JPP abstaining.

In its Opinion C(2026) 9506 adopted on 24 November 2026, the European Commission concluded that France's 2027 Draft Budgetary Plan complies with the maximum growth of net expenditure in the Council Recommendation under the excessive deficit procedure.
Parliament postponed the vote on 24 November 2026 and adopted the amended proposal on 25 November, outside the window, with 367 votes in favour. ([epvotes.com](https://epvotes.com/votes/201194))
The Chamber’s November 24, 2026 voting list records agenda votes but does not identify which, if any, was on STAN’s proposal about the missiles and drone that fell in Poland.

On Tuesday morning, 24 November 2026, ČTK reported Defence Minister Jaromír Zůna's announcement that the cabinet had approved Czech participation in the second phase of the EU SAFE defence-loan programme (following the Monday 23 November cabinet meeting).
ČSÚ’s November 24 release reports a November 2026 seasonally adjusted composite confidence base index of 100.2.

The Conference Board’s initial release reported a November 2026 headline U.S. Consumer Confidence Index of 103.3 (1985=100). ([prnewswire.com](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/us-consumer-confidence-surged-in-november-302949447.html))
The Constitutional Court’s calendar lists a pronouncement for 24 November 2026, but no source I found confirms whether it took place or what the Court decided.

According to ČSÚ's release 'Konjunkturální průzkumy – listopad 2026' published on November 24, 2026, the seasonally adjusted composite confidence indicator (souhrnný indikátor důvěry) for November 2026 stands at 100.2.

On 24 November 2026, the European Parliament voted to postpone the plenary vote on report A10-0290/2026 (procedure 2025/0391(COD)) until 25 November 2026, where it was subsequently adopted with fewer than 400 votes in favour and referred back to committee for interinstitutional negotiations.

Although the Constitutional Court scheduled the public pronouncement of the judgment in case III. ÚS 2839/25 for 24 November 2026, no press release, NALUS entry, weekly summary of judgments, or media report regarding the outcome of this decision has been published yet.
The Conference Board Consumer Confidence Index for November 2026 rose by 11.4 points to 103.3 (1985=100).
Dell’s fiscal Q3 2027 results release raised full-year fiscal 2027 revenue guidance from $192.0 billion to a single-point figure of $202.0 billion.
The ifo Institute’s November 24 press release reported Germany’s November 2026 headline Business Climate Index at 90.6 points (seasonally adjusted, 2015 = 100).
The ifo Business Climate Index for Germany rose to 90.6 points in November 2026, up from 90.1 in October.
In its fiscal Q3 2027 financial results press release issued on November 24, 2026, Dell Technologies stated full-year fiscal 2027 revenue guidance of $202.0 billion, which is above $192.0 billion.
HP Inc.’s earnings release reported non-GAAP diluted net EPS of $0.83 for the fiscal quarter ended October 31, 2026, exceeding the $0.75 threshold.
HP Inc.'s fiscal 2026 fourth quarter earnings press release published on November 24, 2026 states that fourth quarter non-GAAP diluted net EPS was $0.83, which exceeds the $0.75 threshold.

On 24 November 2026, the Chamber of Deputies voted down STAN leader Vít Rakušan's proposal to add the draft resolution condemning the security incident in Poland to the sitting's agenda by a vote of 75 in favour to 91 against.
